Why approvals exist policy, not ceremony

Autonomy is a ladder, not a switch. At L1 (pilot default) every outbound action needs a human. Protective actions — pausing a risky send, suppressing an unsubscribe — never wait. As acceptance stays high, the Gatekeeper proposes graduating action classes to L2/L3, and that change itself requires approval.
